jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

How you'll make an impact

You will play a pivotal role in shaping Dataiku's product positioning, roadmap, and requirements for predictive analytics, machine learning, and GenAI under the responsibilities of the Director of Product Management in charge of Dataiku AI/ML offering. You will work with stakeholders across all parts of the business, including Engineering, Product, GTM, Partners, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success teams, to execute growth projects and new products and features.

Your challenge is to identify and shape net new capabilities: innovations that are core additions to the product, discovered through deep customer engagement and validated before engineering commits. You are not here to maintain what exists in the long run, you will work with Technical Product Managers. You are here to find what's missing and make the case for building it.

If you're ready to step into a role where your expertise leads to tangible, wide-scale impact, where every insight you gather shapes the future of our products, we're waiting for you!

What you’ll be doing

  • Embed with strategic customers to run structured discovery (interviews, async collaboration, or on-site visits) to surface unmet needs before they're obvious to competitors.
  • Analyze usage and customer data to identify gaps and opportunities to enhance customer success and to deliver new capabilities with distinct business value propositions, ultimately contributing to the company's financial goals.
  • Analyze market forces and competition, engage with industry analysts and Dataiku teams to execute on Dataiku’s product strategy. Collaborate with the Product Marketing team to align and deliver on product positioning messages.
  • Build working prototypes (UI mockups, agentic pipeline demos, opportunity memos) to validate hypotheses with customers before engineering commits.
  • Synthesize field signals across accounts to distinguish incremental customer requests from genuine innovation opportunities (net new capabilities that would be core additions to the platform.)
  • Define and champion innovation initiatives from discovery through to launch, at which point ownership transitions to Technical Product Managers for ongoing improvements and maintenance.
  • At launch, partner with Technical Product Managers to produce enablement material for internal customers (Product Marketing and GTM Enablement) ensuring new capabilities and big delighters land with the right positioning, messaging, and field readiness.
  • Maintain the product backlog for the initiatives you own, constantly anticipating and aligning with the global product strategy and the software engineering delivery capacity.
  • Participate in the development, maintenance and education on the AI/ML roadmap. Articulate your team’s technology vision, requirements, goals and milestones to stakeholders.

What you will NOT be doing

  • Managing the full lifecycle of every feature you touch, your focus ends when a capability reaches steady state. You will focus on product discovery and prioritization to maximize value creation and minimize the risk of shipping the right solution to the wrong problem, not on managing maintenance priorities or driving small incremental improvements to existing capabilities.
  • Product management focused on feature development, you work closely with your Technical Product Managers (PO) counterparts to ensure the engineering team gets what they need to deliver the capability at the right time, you do not dive into technical analysis.
  • Shipping production solutions to customers. You build prototypes and demos to get clarity ab

jobs.title: Projektleiter/in - Bau / Senior Project Manager (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

Über die Rolle

Du möchtest die Zukunft des Wohnens aktiv mitgestalten – mit Fokus auf die Umsetzung? Du möchtest ein Team bilden, das mit Spaß an der Arbeit eine gute Performance erreicht? Als Projektleiter/in (m/w/d) bei uns, einem innovativen Generalübernehmer im nachhaltigen Wohnbau, übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Bauprojekte von der Bauantragseinreichung bis zur schlüsselfertigen Übergabe an einen zufriedenen Kunden. Du bist dafür zuständig, dass unsere Wohnbauprojekte (ab 4.500 m2 BGF aufwärts) termin- und qualitätsgerecht realisiert werden und verantwortest dabei die Kosten und Zahlungsströme.  

Insbesondere werden deine Aufgaben umfassen:

  • Eigenverantwortliche Planung, Koordination und Steuerung von Bauprojekten im Roh- und Schlüsselfertigbau unter Berücksichtigung der wirtschaftlichen und technischen Zielsetzung
  • Termingerechte und qualitätssichere Umsetzung des vertraglichen Bau-Solls
  • Kontrolle des Bauablaufs und der Baustellenergebnisse
  • Koordinieren und überwachen der Einsätze von Fachingenieuren, Fachberater, Personal sowie Nachunternehmen
  • Führung und Organisation des Baustellenteams und Verantwortung über die Personaleinsatzplanung
  • Management von Kosten und Zahlungsströmen
  • Verhandlungsführung mit Auftraggebern und Nachunternehmen
  • Nachtragsgestaltung und -durchsetzung gegenüber den Auftraggebern 

Über dich

  • Einen Studienabschluss in der Fachrichtung Bauingenieurwesen oder Architektur bzw. eine vergleichbare Qualifikation  
  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung beim Bau von Großprojekten, idealerweise bei einem GU oder GÜ  
  • Reisebereitschaft zu unseren Baustellen deutschlandweit - du trägst die Projektverantwortung und entscheidest selbst, wann deine  Anwesenheit vor Ort notwendig ist
  • Einen sicheren im Umgang mit Office Produkten (Excel, Word...) und gängigen Projekt Management Softwares
  • Erfahrung in der Ressourceneinsatzplanung, Lean Construction ist ein Plus
  • Einen transparenten und kooperativen Kommunikationsstil sowie ein starkes Verhandlungsgeschick und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Teamgeist und eine selbstständige sowie verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise
  • Begeisterung für digitale Anwendungen und innovative Prozessgestaltung
  • Fließende Deutsch und gute Englischkenntnisse 

Was wir bieten

  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.
  • Virtuelles Aktienprogramm: Profitiere von GROPYUS Erfolg durch unser Virtuelles Aktienprogramm.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.

jobs.description:

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market, in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.  
 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter?  Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 
 Become a part of our mission and learn  more  about our Product & Tech team! 

 Deine Position As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value. In your role you will: 
 Drive Your Own Initiatives:  Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes. 

 Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products:  Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives. 

 Support Regulatory Product Launches:  Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions. 

 Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes:  Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable. 

 Monitor Performance & Iterate:  Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction. 

 Prepare & Present : Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Banking / Fintech / Consulting)
jobs.description:
Thoughtworks partners with clients to build impactful digital products which deliver extraordinary customer experiences. We do this by integrating design, strategy and technology. We’re looking for a seasoned product leader, with experience in identifying, launching and scaling new products and product portfolio and with a background in Banking / Financial Services / Fintech and Consulting to join the Customer Experience, Product and Design (CXPD) service line.

Job responsibilities

  • As a trusted advisor to our client’s leadership, you will partner with them to understand their context and needs, make recommendations, and provide advice and hands-on expertise on taking new products from concept to market to scale.
  • Drive the innovation mindset and the overall product development lifecycle, utilising lean and hypothesis driven approaches to identify, conceptualise and pilot new products that deliver undeniable value. 
  • Establish the market & competitive landscape, go to market strategy and business case or economic model for the opportunity with our clients. 
  • Lead the stakeholders to think about customer’s problems, business outcomes and take them on the change journey of moving to empowered product teams that create strategic growth for the organisation.
  • Shape and lead teams to deliver client engagements in a way which is both effective for our client and operationally sound for Thoughtworks.
  • Help shape CXPD service line value propositions, creating case studies, points of view and other content through insights on client needs and solutions, and also through defining repeatable practices which will help us to scale our efforts.
  • Get involved in pre-sales, creating proposals and pitches, shaping engagements for clients and helping to educate both clients and colleagues about the value of our services.
  • Contribute to the growth and scale of our evolving business through taking an active part in recruiting, community building, mentorship and driving continuous improvement in practices and techniques.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in leading new ideas from concept to launch and scale with expertise in go-to-market strategy and developing new revenue streams.
  • Experience in commercial and economic modelling, including monetisation strategy.
  • Experience in bringing an innovation mindset into an organisation at scale and creating sustained innovation investment across strategic horizons.
  • Depth in conducting research and bringing market trends, customer and competitive insights to facilitate strategic ideation to identify opportunities for strategic growth.
  • Depth and expertise in developing value proposition, using lean approaches to test viability, feasibility and desirable to achieve problem-solution and product-market fit before scaling.
  • Demonstrated hypothesis and data driven problem-solving orientation with exceptional ability to create structured quantitative and qualitative analyses.
  • Operate at company, portfolio and product level — defining and executing a strategy, shaping a vision and translating it into a roadmap with clear business and customer value-based measures of success.
  • Advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive the change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery and measurement and making innovation mainstream.
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices.

Professional Skills

  • Skilled at operating and building relationships with C-suite executives and confident in driving conversations at the intersection of technology and business.
  • Strong interpersonal skills — active listening, persuading and empathising with others and excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to formulate and deliver insights around complex business problems in a thoughtful and persuasive manner.
  • Strong consulting skills and can operate with ambiguity.
  • Bias for action, and can break down complex problems into tangible steps.
  • Enjoy collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and can operate as an advisory but also as a hands on practitioner.
  • Passionate about creating thought-leadership and representing our brand and value proposition in external events, and by writing articles or white papers.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Numan 

 

 Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health. 

 

 Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. 

 

 To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 

 

 • Patients first. 

 • Learn fast. 

 • Own the quality. 

 • Succeed together. 

 • Care deeply. 

 

 Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! 
 

 The role: 

 
 This role is about taking our platform to the next level: moving toward sophisticated, predictive, and learning-based decisioning, with a clear path toward becoming a regulated medical device.

 This is a senior, high-impact individual contributor (IC) role for someone who combines deep system understanding with clinical product judgement and real experience deploying AI/ML. You are AI-enabled, well-resourced, and measure your success by what you ship and move, rather than the size of your team. You move comfortably between high-level strategy and engineering-grade specifics.

 You'll be: 
 
 
 
 Lead the product direction and roadmap for the decision platform, from long-term strategy down to the detail of how a rule actually works.

 
 Decide which features and capabilities create the most scalable value, balancing near-term execution with strategic bets.

 
 Establish and systematically track the success metrics for the platform.

 
 
 Set the direction for how the platform uses AI and machine learning, embedding predictive and supervised learning systems into production.

 
 Build self-learning systems so the platform continuously improves on its historical recommendations while keeping safety and explainability central.

 
 Read and reason about system architecture. Act as a credible equal in technical debates with engineers, making sharp trade-offs between speed-to-value and long-term scalability.

 
 
 Help shape the product side of the platform's regulatory direction, including the decision to build it as Software/AI as a Medical Device (SaMD).

 
 Work fluently with sensitive patient data, partnering with clinical and quality colleagues to ensure safety and patient trust fundamentally shape the roadmap.

 
 
 Proactively show engineering, clinical, design, and other product teams what the platform makes possible, while staying pragmatic about what they can absorb today.

 

 You'll need: 
 

 
 A proven track record as a Senior or Principal Technical PM on complex platform, infrastructure, or systems products.

 
 Hands-on experience deploying machine learning in production, specifically supervised learning or predictive systems.

 
 Experience deploying or regulating software/AI as a medical device (SaMD), or working within closely comparable regulated frameworks.

 
 Direct experience working with rules engines, knowledge graphs, or AI-driven decisioning systems.

 
 Experience in clinical, healthcare, or adjacent domains handling sensitive, highly detailed user data.

 
 Experience operating as a high-velocity individual contributor who leverages AI tools to cover ground that would traditionally require multiple people.

 It's a bonus if you have: 
 

 
 Experience scaling platform products across multiple international regulatory frameworks.

 
 Prior experience working directly as a data scientist or software engineer before transitioning into technical product management.

 
 Experience dealing with complex biological or personalized health data points.

 Our benefits include...

 🏖 - 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 the longer you stay with Numan). 

 🩺 - Health insurance with Vitality .

 🥳 - A day off on your Birthday! 

 🐥 - Nursery benefit provided by YellowNest . 

 💼 - Employee assistance programme (access to therapy, financial planning and discounts). 

 ⚖️ - Generous pension (includes both employee and employer contributions). 

 💻 - Flexible working options, including a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. 

 📚 - Personal training and development budget via Learnerbly. 

 👟 - Wellhub membership, giving you access to over 2,000 locations in the UK. 

 🚲 - Cycle to work scheme. 

 🚆 - Season ticket loan. 

 % - Discount on Numan products for your friends and family. 

 🤲 - Paid volunteering days.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Numan 

 

 Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health. 

 

 Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. 

 

 To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 

 

 • Patients first. 

 • Learn fast. 

 • Own the quality. 

 • Succeed together. 

 • Care deeply. 

 

 Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! 
 

 
 The Role 

 At Numan, we’re building a new generation of intelligent healthcare experiences that combine the best of human expertise and system intelligence to help people live healthier, happier, longer lives. This role sits at the centre of that ambition, leading product for our Core Experience team as we redefine how patients interact with healthcare across mobile, conversational and AI-powered experiences. 

 You’ll be responsible for translating product strategy into exceptional execution, ensuring our teams solve the right problems, build the right solutions, and deliver measurable improvements for both patients and the business. You’ll own the delivery of the Core Experience product while influencing the strategy, discovery and cross-functional decisions that shape its future. 

 We’re looking for someone with exceptional product judgement, strong delivery capability, and the ability to combine strategy, discovery and execution into consistently outstanding product outcomes. 

 You'll be: 

 
 Strategy & Prioritisation: Translate high-level business objectives into clear roadmaps and actionable execution plans. Own the prioritisation matrix, balancing patient value, business impact, and technical feasibility.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Organic Growth
jobs.description:
The Opportunity 

 

HelloFresh is the world's leading meal-kit company, serving millions of subscribers across 18 markets. Historically, we have grown through paid acquisition, but the way people discover food is changing twice over. Search is being reshaped by AI, and a new generation of consumers is asking ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity to "plan dinner for my family this week" instead of opening an app or a search engine. Whoever shows up in those answers wins the category-default position. Whoever does not is invisible.

We own the meal-kit category in organic search and in LLMs. The broader food and recipe universe, where 150M+ monthly searches live, is still dominated by publishers with decades of content authority. Closing that gap is one of the largest, most durable growth opportunities in the business, and it is the mandate of the Organic Growth squad.

We're hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead Organic Growth and level it up from a traditional SEO function into a modern organic discovery engine spanning SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and an emerging Agentic Commerce mandate. This is the single-threaded leadership role for how HelloFresh and Factor get discovered, cited, and chosen across Google and AI surfaces.

 

The role 

 

You will own the end-to-end product strategy for organic discovery technical SEO, content infrastructure at scale, GEO and AI visibility, and the early Agentic Commerce surface that turns discovery into action inside LLMs. You'll inherit a real foundation: a quality-first content strategy, recipe-collection automation, a GEO editorial framework, and a shipped Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App proof-of-concept. Your job is to take that to a responsible scale. You will set the direction for a cross-functional squad Product, Engineering, Data/ML, SEO, Content/Editorial, and UX and act as the connective tissue across Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial. You will operate with high agency and a strong bias for ownership: this role is for a builder who takes accountability for outcomes, not just outputs.

 

What you'll own 

 

SEO-the engine 

  • End-to-end technical and content SEO across HelloFresh and Factor: crawlability, indexation, structured data, internal linking, SSR, sitemaps, and CMS/content-platform infrastructure.
  • Content scale with guardrails: recipe detail pages, automated recipe collection pages, editorial/blog, recipe internationalization, and UGC signals (ratings, reviews, authorship) — growing the footprint without falling into the content-debt trap.
  • Move the org from meal-kit catalog to food destination: identify high-volume recipe and food queries where we have no page, and build them.

 

GEO-the next surface 

  • Own AI visibility and citation share across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity, measured via Profound across a priority set of food and meal-kit prompts.
  • Drive our +25ppt GEO Visibility Score target (HF + Factor) by EOY 2026 through GEO-specific content formats built for AI citation, narrative-shaping editorial, and coordinated signals across owned, editorial, PR/affiliate, and social surfaces.
  • Operationalize "good SEO is good GEO" while owning the GEO-only tactics (comparison/listicle content, third-party narrative, non-Google LLM optimization) that pure SEO misses.

 

Agentic Commerce-the emerging bet 

  • Extend organic discovery from "showing up" to "converting": connect GEO presence to our Agentic Commerce surface so discovery in an LLM turns into action.
  • Partner with New Ventures on the Discovery MCP / ChatGPT App and the hub-and-spoke platform (MCP / Apps SDK, then Claude and Gemini), helping shape funnel and active-experience coverage as the space matures.

 

Connect discovery to engagement

  • Route food-intent traffic into the Cooking Companion / Cookbook experience (web-to-app save, cook-along, shopping lists) to build daily active users, not just sessions.
  • Own one integrated, prioritized organic-discovery roadmap that keeps content, product, engineering, data, and AI measurement connected.

 

Raise the bar & lead through influence

  • Set the standard for product thinking, experimentation rigor, and quality-first sequencing across the squad.
  • Drive alignment across Marketing, Brand, PR, and Commercial on a single repeated message and a shared definition of organic success.

 

What you'll bring 

 

  • Deep SEO expertise (must-have): 6+ years in product management with hands-on ownership of technical and content SEO

jobs.title: Product Manager Business Systems (Payments & Revenue) (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Zur EXARING AG 
 Wir entwickeln und betreiben die TV-Plattform waipu.tv und sind Marktführer in Deutschland für unabhängiges IPTV. waipu.tv erreicht inzwischen über sechs Millionen Nutzer in Deutschland und erzielt mit Abstand die besten Kundenbewertungen im Markt. Neben klassischem Fernsehen bietet waipu.tv auch über 40.000 Filme und Serien auf Abruf. Unsere Kunden lieben die Flexibilität, mobil oder über das WLAN in allen Räumen und mit allen Geräten ihre Unterhaltung genießen zu können. Die Aufnahme-, Pause- und Restart-Funktion bietet zusätzlich eine Unabhängigkeit von starren Sendezeiten.
 
 Damit im Hintergrund alles reibungslos funktioniert, müssen Zahlungen verarbeitet, Abonnements verwaltet, Business-Partner abgerechnet, Betrugsversuche erkannt und aussagekräftige Reports erstellt werden.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Finance-Experten. Wir suchen jemanden, der komplexe Prozesse versteht, gerne analytisch arbeitet und Spaß daran hat, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und Entwicklern intelligente Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Wenn Du Geschäftsprozesse lieber neu denkst als verwaltest und Daten für Dich mehr sind als Tabellen, solltest Du weiterlesen.
 

 Deine Mission

Gemeinsam mit Finance, Business Intelligence, Engineering und unseren Softwarepartnern entwickelst Du unsere Business-Systeme rund um Payments und Revenue kontinuierlich weiter. Dabei sorgst Du dafür, dass Prozesse einfacher, intelligenter und stärker automatisiert werden und wir jederzeit auf verlässliche Daten und Kennzahlen vertrauen können.
 
 
 Das erwartet Dich

 Prozesse gestalten statt verwalten

 Business und Technologie verbinden

 Daten intelligent nutzen

 Automatisierung vorantreiben
 Du identifizierst manuelle Abläufe, entwickelst Automatisierungskonzepte und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
 
 Fraud bekämpfen
 Du entwickelst unsere Prozesse zur Fraud Detection & Prevention kontinuierlich weiter und nutzt Datenanalysen, um Risiken frühzeitig zu erkennen.
 
 Business-Plattformen weiterentwickeln

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

Some businesses run one location. Others run hundreds, across different brands, different owners, and different rules for what can be shared between them. Making one platform work brilliantly for both is a genuinely hard product problem and it's the one our team solves every day.

We're looking for a Staff PM to own a critical part of that problem end to end. This is a role where you set direction, build the case for what we invest in next, and raise the product craft of the team around you not just ship features. You'll work directly with a technical Director and a team that moves fast on problems that matter to businesses managing real scale.

Your mission, should you choose to accept it:

  • Own the product direction for how Mews serves multi-location and multi-brand businesses
  • Lead strategy and the investment case for some of our most ambitious product bets this year
  • Make the hard calls on complex trade-offs, in close partnership with senior engineers
  • Lead discovery that spans genuinely different customer types and turn it into a clear roadmap
  • Coach and raise the bar for the product managers and builders around you
  • Represent this product area in broader company planning and strategy

You'll be a great fit if you bring a few of the below with you:

  • 8+ years in product, including genuine Staff or Principal PM experience owning a full product domain
  • Strong technical fluency — comfortable as a peer to senior engineers, not just a translator
  • A track record leading complex, multi-stakeholder discovery and turning it into strategy
  • Experience building frameworks or standards that raise the product bar for a whole team
  • Comfortable with AI tools as a core part of how you work
  • Experience with multi-location, multi-brand or multi-entity SaaS platforms is a strong plus — hospitality experience is not required

That complexity creates real demand for better data, better insight and clearer thinking about how all of it fits together - with this role sitting at the centre of that challange! 

 

The role:

As our Senior Data Product Manager, you’ll sit right at the intersection of product, analytics, engineering and senior leadership, helping define the data products that power smarter decisions across Liberis. You’ll have real ownership over roadmap, prioritisation and ways of working, and your work will directly influence how teams access, understand and use data day to day. This role is a high-impact opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a business uses data at scale! You’ll be joining a team with a broad remit and a genuine mandate to improve the data experience across the company, so there’s a lot of scope to make the role your own and shape the future of the domain.

You will own the data and insights product for Liberis, building the foundations that let our commercial, credit and operations teams actually understand the business they're running. That means, thinking carefully about the entities in our data model, how products and customers relate to each other, how those relationships surface in reporting and analysis - and how it eventually all comes out in great dashboards, tools and self-serve capabilities. This is about shipping products which are genuinely useful, not just technically correct.

Our Engineering Team is going through an AI-first transformation, rethinking how teams are structured and how they ship. Data, insights and analytics are a crucial part of that journey and you will be a key player in leading, innovating and rapidly improving our posture and capabilities at the intersection of data and AI.

If you like solving genuinely hard problems, bringing clarity to complex environments and building products that have visible business impact - this is the role for you! 

 

What you'll do:

Your primary job is to help Liberis's commercial decision makers understand the small businesses we serve and how they consider, use and perform across our product range. Doing this well requires a clear conceptual model of the business and a willingness to engage with stakeholders across the business, as well as taste and customer empathy in developing a great insights product including dashboards, insight tools and self-serve capabilities.

You will own the roadmap for our internal data & insight products. You will run prioritisation, manage the backlog and make decisions about where effort goes. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
jobs.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Cyprus; London, United Kingdom; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (m/w/d) Creator Platforms
jobs.description:
Die campoint AG ist Technologiepartner und Betreiber einer der größten deutschsprachigen Plattformen für die Creator Economy und Digital Entertainment - von der Consumer-Plattform bis zur B2B-Infrastruktur, mit der Creators und Agenturen ihr Business aufbauen und steuern. Dabei sind Creators für uns keine User, sondern Unternehmer, deren Erfolg unmittelbar von unseren Produkten abhängt. Das bestimmt, wie wir priorisieren. Wir gestalten nach unserer Vision. Wir leben von Teamplay, Hands-on-Mentalität und einer Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.

 Aufgaben

 Du bekommst echte Ownership für zugewiesene Produkt-Streams innerhalb unseres B2B-Portfolios. Das bedeutet: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird und was nicht - auf Basis von Creator-Feedback, Umsatzdaten und strategischem Rahmen. Wir haben keine langen Abstimmungsrunden. Du bist das Quality-Gateway für Dein Team und Eure Releases.

 Du navigierst eigenständig durch ein komplexes Stakeholder-Umfeld. Wir erwarten, dass Du Konflikte direkt löst - nicht eskalierst.

 Die strategische Richtung gibt der Head of Product vor. Deine Aufgabe ist es, sie mit hoher Eigenständigkeit und Qualitätsanspruch umzusetzen und innerhalb Deiner Streams bessere Entscheidungen zu treffen, als wenn er sie selbst treffen würde.

 Das ist kein Stepping-Stone in die Produktstrategie. Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der im Operativen exzellent ist und das als Stärke sieht, nicht als Einschränkung.

 
 Du verantwortest Discovery, Priorisierung und Delivery in Deinen Produkt-Streams von Anfang bis Ende.

 Du übersetzt qualitative Creator-Insights und starke Signale direkt in mutige Entscheidungen - ohne Dich in endlosen Datenanalysen ("Analysis Paralysis") zu verlieren.

 Du schreibst klare Specs und Tickets, die ohne Nacharbeit ins Development gehen.

 Du erkennst, wann ein Prozess oder Sprint-Ritual der schnellen Problemlösung im Weg steht, und brichst es pragmatisch in Absprache mit dem Team auf.

 Du holst externe Impulse aktiv rein und arbeitest sie pragmatisch ein.

 Du behältst den Überblick über technische Abhängigkeiten, ohne Dich in ihnen zu verlieren.

 
 Qualifikation

 Must-haves: 

 
 Du hast 4–6 Jahre Erfahrung als PO oder PM in einem digitalen Produkt-Umfeld mit nachweisbarer Execution-Qualität, nicht nur Prozess-Compliance.

 Du baust Dir schnell echtes Verständnis von Plattform-Logik, Creator-Mindset und wirtschaftlichen Zusammenhängen auf.

 Du besitzt ein hohes UX-Gespür und ästhetisches Urteil: Du erkennst intuitiv gute Usability und kannst Design-Entscheidungen aus Creator-Sicht begründen, statt sie nur analytisch zu zerlegen.

 Du verfügst über eine wirtschaftliche und psychologische Intuition rund um Monetarisierung, Nutzerverhalten und Einkommenspsychologie.

 Deine Sprachkenntnisse: Deutsch fließend, Englisch working proficiency.

 
 AI-Skills: 

 
 Du nutzt AI-Tools (Claude Cowork, ChatGPT o.ä.) selbstverständlich für Discovery, Spec-Writing und Priorisierung - nicht als Spielerei, sondern um schneller zu besseren Entscheidungen zu kommen.

 Du bewertest AI-Output kritisch, statt ihn unreflektiert zu übernehmen - Du erkennst Halluzinationen und schwache Annahmen.

 Du verstehst, wo AI in unseren Produkten selbst Creator-Mehrwert schaffen kann und denkst das aktiv in Deiner Priorisierung mit.

 
 Nice-to-have: 

 
 Du besitzt Erfahrung mit Creator-/Freelancer-Plattformen, Subscription-Flows oder Content-Monetarisierung.

 Du hast bereits in einem regulatorisch komplexen Umfeld gearbeitet.

 Du verfügst über Erfahrung mit Prompt-Engineering oder dem Aufbau AI-gestützter Workflows/Agenten in Deinem bisherigen PM-Alltag.

 
 Benefits

 
 Flexibilität, die passt: Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Option auf Remote-Arbeit gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitstag so, wie er für Dich am besten funktioniert.

 Inspiration und Freiraum: Unser moderner Campus bietet nicht nur ein kreatives Arbeitsumfeld, sondern auch einen eigenen Outdoor-Bereich mit Grill- und Volleyballplatz – der perfekte Ort, um Energie zu tanken und neue Ideen zu entwickeln.

 Dein Wachstum, unser Antrieb: Wir investieren in Deine Weiterbildung! Ob durch unser vielfältiges Trainingsangebot oder individuelle Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten – wir unterstützen Dich auf Deinem Weg.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Einleitung Bei Peter Park ist "Product" nicht einfach nur ein Unternehmensbereich. Hier trifft alles aufeinander: Wohin wir als Unternehmen wollen, was wir verkaufen, wie wir wachsen, was unsere Kunden erleben. Als Group Product Manager verantwortest du eine Product Area im Produktmanagement, führst ein Team von Product Managern und arbeitest täglich mit einem breiten Stakeholder-Feld zusammen. Wenn du wirklich gestalten und führen willst, ist das die richtige Stelle.

 Was ist Deine Aufgabe? People Leadership, Coaching & Culture: Du hast die volle disziplinarische Verantwortung für ein Team von 2–3 Product Managern und prägst die Teamkultur mit dem Ziel, wachsende Eigenverantwortung und Empowerment im Team zu entwickeln.
 Produktstrategie & Alignment: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die Strategie für deine Product Area und stellst das kontinuierliche Alignment mit unseren Unternehmenszielen sicher. Du managst den Produktlebenszyklus und pflegst den Product Governance Prozess – schnell liefern, ohne Qualität zu opfern.
 Business Impact & Markt: Du steuerst Ressourcen für maximalen Impact und bewertest und verbesserst kontinuierlich die Kundenzufriedenheit auf Area-Ebene. Dafür hast du Markttrends und den Wettbewerb stets im Blick.
 Stakeholder-Management: Du hältst für deine Product Area die Fäden zusammen und hast stets das große Ganze im Blick. Dabei kommunizierst du sicher mit unterschiedlichen Unternehmensbereichen und Managementebenen.
 

 Deine Fähigkeiten: Du bringst 7+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung als Senior PM, Lead PM oder Team Lead im Product Management mit – idealerweise in einem schnellwachsenden Start-up, Scale-up, SaaS- oder IoT-Umfeld.
 Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der disziplinarischen oder fachlichen Führung.
 Du hast eigenständig eine Produktstrategie auf Area-Ebene entwickelt und verantwortet – inkl. Roadmap-Planung.
 Du arbeitest sicher mit agilen Methoden und bist vertraut mit Outcome-Metriken und datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung.
 Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen und eine ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur internen Kollaboration.
 Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership für komplexe Themen und verlierst dabei nie das große Ganze aus dem Blick.
 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse.
 

 Work Setup: 40 Stunden pro Woche (Vertrauensbasis)
 Homeoffice Policy: 3 Tage im Office / 2 Tage remote
 Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
 Arbeitsort: München
 Team: 6 Kolleg:innen
 

 Welche Vorteile bietet mir Peter Park? So sieht Dein Arbeitsalltag bei uns aus 
 Arbeiten mit Bergblick: Unser Büro in der Neuen Balan bietet mehr als nur moderne Ausstattung: Von der Dachterrasse aus genießt Du ein Alpenpanorama, im Sommer wird gemeinsam gegrillt, und unsere Teamevents sorgen für gute Stimmung.
 Teamgeist und Impact-Kultur: Bei uns zählt Deine Stimme! Wir leben flache Hierarchien und eine Kultur des "Du" vom ersten Tag an. Das bedeutet: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch mit allen Ebenen und ein Team, das Dich aktiv unterstützt. Deine Ideen sind hier nicht nur willkommen, sondern werden gehört.
 Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und kannst Deine Ideen aktiv einbringen. Wir fördern Deine Entwicklung – mit echtem Vertrauen in Deine Fähigkeiten.
 Das bieten wir Dir zusätzlich

jobs.title: Working Student Product Management Energy Products & Tariffs (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

 At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

 We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market, in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

 Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

 Become a part of our mission and learn about our Product & Tech team!

 Deine Position

 As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value. In your role you will:

 
 Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

 Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.

 Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

 Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

 Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.

 Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

 
 Dein Profil

 
 You are enrolled at a university for at least two more semesters and can support us 15-20 hours per week during the semester, with up to 40 hours per week during semester breaks

 You are studying Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a comparable course of studies

 You have a keen interest in the energy market, energy tariffs, and the energy transition, with a strong motivation to drive impactful change

 You have experience with and enjoy working in Google Sheets/Excel: SQL or Python skills are a plus

 You are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable managing multiple projects at the same time

 You are a problem solver, able to adapt to changing environments and stakeholder needs

 Previous experience in the energy sector, product management, or consulting is a plus, but we're happy to get you up to speed - motivation counts!

 Excellent language skills in English and German (both written and spoken)

 
 Benefits

 
 You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

 With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

 Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

 You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

 You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups

 You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

 Flexible working hours that fit around your university schedule

 Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - New Business
jobs.description:
Location: Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona

At Freenow, we are on a mission to empower smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Strategy & New Business team. You will own a vertical focused on complex, high-value order types, the kind that don't fit into a simple A-to-B booking and require real product thinking to scale. Think multi-leg journeys, recurring enterprise needs, scheduled operations, and bespoke partner requirements. This list is not exhaustive the space is wide and still being defined.

You will set the vision for your vertical, build the roadmap from scratch, and take full ownership of outcomes. This is not an execution role with a predefined plan. You are the one who creates the plan.

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:

  • Define the product vision and long-term strategy for your vertical
  • Build and prioritize the roadmap based on commercial opportunity and operational impact
  • Write clear, detailed specifications that engineering teams can build from independently
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Sales, Operations, Legal, and Core Tech
  • Identify and resolve ambiguity early in requirements, in processes, and in stakeholder expectations
  • Track KPIs and use data to validate direction and drive decisions

 

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a senior role 
  • Background in marketplace, or operations-heavy products B2B/B2C
  • Proven ability to define product vision and build strategy, not just execute one
  • Strong experience managing complex stakeholder environments across multiple teams
  • Comfortable working with incomplete information
  • Exceptional written communication, your specs and documents set the standard for the team
  • Self-directed and accountable: you own outcomes, not just deliverables
  • Fluent in English; German is a significant advantage

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:

  • Flexible working arrangements
  • LinkedIn Learning
  • Sabbatical & special leave policies
  • WeRoad partnership
  • Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
  • Short term EU work policy
  • Mobility Credit
  • Health Insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  

 

Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

 

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.
We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work. 

ABOUT FREENOW:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. 

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager, LatAm (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google and Booking.com.
 
 We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
 
 As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you will lead our most strategically important client projects in the region.
 
 What you will do: 
 Lead pre-sales and delivery of complex API and e-commerce projects, acting as the primary point of contact for external partners, while facilitating collaboration between their teams and Distribusion’s Engineering, Product, and Operations functions.

 Develop blueprint processes for the rollout of standard product offerings.

 Guide product development by systematically capturing market needs and partner insights.
 

 Workplace: Berlin/Hybrid or Europe/Remote. 
We collaborate with teams around the Globe and our HQ in Berlin, where the Berlin team often meets in the office.
 
 Who you are: 
 You have 4+ years managing technical projects or solution delivery, including in a consulting or high growth environment

 You are confident navigating technical topics like API integrations, architecture diagrams, and e-commerce, even if you’re not the one coding.

 You’re a structured communicator who can translate complexity into clarity for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 You take ownership, thrive in ambiguity, and are energised by solving cross-functional coordination challenges.

 You are business fluent in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

 You are open to business travel to our key markets in Latin America.

 
 What you can expect: 
 You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry.

 You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and directly impact the company's success.

 We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.

 You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

jobs.title: Senior Commercial Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

 

Über die Rolle:

  • Kaufmännische Betreuung und Steuerung von Bauprojekten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der technischen Projekt- und Bauleitung
  • Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Budgets, Kosten- und Ergebniszielen und frühzeitige Identifizierung von Chancen und Risiken im Projektverlauf.
  • Erstellung, Prüfung und Bearbeitung von Nachunternehmer-, Lieferanten-, Abschlags- und Schlussrechnungen
  • Vertragsmanagement gegenüber Auftraggebern, Nachunternehmern und Lieferanten einschließlich der Begleitung vertraglicher Fragestellungen
  • Prüfung und Freigabe von Rechnungen sowie Sicherstellung eines ordnungsgemäßen Zahlungs- und Forderungsmanagements
  • Erstellung aussagekräftiger kaufmännischer Reportings, Analysen und Forecasts für interne und externe Stakeholder
  • Steuerung, Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung kaufmännischer Prozesse innerhalb der Projekte sowie Sicherstellung einer vollständigen und nachvollziehbaren Projektdokumentation
  • Kaufmännische Begleitung von Ausschreibungs-, Vergabe- und Beschaffungsprozessen unter Berücksichtigung wirtschaftlicher und strategischer Aspekte
  • Beratung der technischen Projektleitung und des Managements als kaufmännischer Sparringspartner bei wirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen und Projektentscheidungen
  • Kommunikation und Verhandlung mit Auftraggebern, Nachunternehmern, Lieferanten, Behörden, Banken und weiteren externen Partnern
  • Identifikation, Bewertung und Steuerung projektrelevanter kaufmännischer Chancen und Risiken zur Sicherstellung des nachhaltigen Projekterfolgs

 

Über dich: 

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Baukauffrau/-mann oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Bauwirtschaft, vorzugsweise bei einem Generalübernehmer oder Bauunternehmen 
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und idealerweise ERP-Systemen wie RIB iTWO, SAP oder vergleichbaren Bau-Softwarelösungen 
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise 
  • Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke 
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
  • Bereitschaft ab und zu nach Berlin zu reisen für einen persönlichen Austausch mit deinem Team (solltest du nicht in Berlin oder Umgebung wohnen)

 

Was wir bieten:

  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Flexible Arbeitsweise: Wir legen großen Wert auf regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Büro, und bieten auch die Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie die Option, bis zu 40 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (VCS Ecosystem)
jobs.location: Amsterdam, Netherlands; Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; London, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Remote, Germany; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
jobs.description:
You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.

As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools. You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams. Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Day to day, you will:

  • Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
  • Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
  • Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
  • Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on. 
  • Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
  • Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
  • Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

What you’ll bring

  • A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
  • Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
  • The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
  • Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
  • A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
  • An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
  • A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.

What you’ll need

  • Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
  • The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
  • Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
  • A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
  • Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
  • As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.

What success looks like

Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists. You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us 

 Canary Technologies is changing the game for hotels with modern software powered by Canary's hospitality-specific AI platform. 

 

 Canary is utilized by 20,000+ hoteliers in 100+ countries to equip hoteliers with the technology they need to work smarter and wow their guests. Major hotel brands such as Wyndham, Marriott, IHG, Four Seasons, Rosewood, and Best Western trust Canary to deliver results. 

 

 Canary was named a 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, a Most Innovative Company by Fast Company and a HotelTechReport Best Place to Work — and is backed by top Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, F-Prime, Brighton Park Capital and Insight Partners. 

 

 Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! 

 
 

 
 About the Role

 Canary is at the forefront of providing AI-powered technology solutions to the hospitality industry. Our mission is to help hotels modernize operations, enhance guest experiences, and drive business results through intuitive, digital-first products. Our innovative platform is trusted by hotels worldwide for its ability to streamline operations and improve guest satisfaction.

 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our growing team and help lead the development of impactful products across key areas of our platform. In this role, you’ll take ownership of complex problem spaces, work closely with cross-functional partners, and drive initiatives that are critical to Canary’s continued growth and customer success.

 You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of high-leverage product areas , such as:

 
 Guest communication

 Digital check-in

 Payments

 Upsells

 And more!

 
 As part of a globally distributed team, you’ll collaborate regularly with colleagues and customers across time zones—so flexibility, asynchronous communication, and strong cross-cultural collaboration skills are essential.

 If you are a strong product thinker with at least 5 years of product management experience , and you’re excited to help shape the future of hospitality tech, we’d love to connect.

 Responsibilities 
 

 Define and execute product strategy, roadmap, and delivery plans for the Canary platform.

 Partner with Engineering and Design teams to bring intuitive, scalable, and reliable features to life.

 Collaborate with stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure successful product launches and strong customer adoption.

 Conduct in-depth customer research and product analysis to inform prioritization and uncover new opportunities.

 Translate complex customer and business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.

 Set clear goals and success metrics, and use data to drive continuous improvement and iteration.

 Help mentor product managers and contribute to the broader product culture and processes.

 Qualifications 

 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS or a technology-driven environment.

 Proven ability to define and ship successful products that deliver measurable business outcomes.

 Strong product intuition and customer empathy—you understand how to solve real problems with elegant, user-focused solutions.

 Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to drive execution in an agile environment.

 Skilled at making data-informed decisions while remaining grounded in customer feedback.

 Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

 Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

 Experience working across time zones within globally distributed teams.

 Bonus : Experience in hospitality technology, messaging platforms, payments, or AI/ automation is a plus.

 EU Compensation 
 
 Target cash compensation ranges from €140,000 - €175,000, including a fixed annual salary and a performance-based bonus paid quarterly. 

 This role also includes a stock option grant, subject to board approval. 

 Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's skill level, experience, and specific work location. 

 We also work hard to ensure Canary is a fun and exciting place to work! Here are some of the additional benefits:

 

 Canary Days: As a company we want to ensure that the team has time to recharge. Each month we provide company wide days off to ensure there is at least one extended weekend or day off.

 

 Self Improvement Club: We meet each month and share our personal goals for the month. Each individual is provided a budget towards any purchases that help us achieve these goals.

 

 Professional Development Chats: We provide budget to help drive cross functional professional development conversations across the organization.

 

 Travel Reimbursement: Team members are able to visit our offices across New York, San Francisco or Dallas when they choose, and are provided a travel stipend for doing so. Spend time working with the team in their office, and use the rest of your time

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
You will own the roadmap for a core part of Diligent’s governance, risk and compliance SaaS platform, shaping how senior leaders and boards collaborate, communicate and make decisions in a secure, modern way. You’ll turn customer problems and market insights into simple, impactful product experiences, and work closely with engineering, design, and go‑to‑market teams to bring them to life. 

In this Senior Product Manager role, you’ll spend your time deeply understanding customer needs, prioritising what truly moves the needle, and defining clear success metrics for everything you ship. You’ll lead a cross‑functional squad, manage the product backlog, and launch features that drive engagement, adoption and measurable outcomes for our customers across the Diligent Platform. 

Here’s a breakdown of what you’ll do (not all of it, just the important stuff) 

  • Own and continuously refine the product roadmap for your area, using customer insight, data and market trends to prioritise what to build next. 
  • Define and drive product strategy that aligns with Diligent’s vision for modern governance, connecting your roadmap to clear business and customer outcomes. 
  • Act as the voice of the customer: run discovery, validate problems and solutions, and translate insights into clear user stories and product requirements. 
  • Lead an agile, cross‑functional team (engineering, UX, product marketing, sales, customer success) to design, build and launch high‑quality SaaS features. 
  • Set goals, KPIs and success metrics for your product, track performance and user engagement, and iterate based on what the data and customers tell you.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - Token Factory
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Role

As a Technical Project Manager in Token Factory, your primary focus will be coordinating complex cross-functional projects, including new region launches, engineering quality and platform-wide improvement projects, and the end-to-end delivery pipeline for new AI models. You will bring together multiple engineering teams, understand the critical path, proactively manage dependencies and risks, and ensure that ambitious technical goals are delivered predictably, on time, and without unnecessary operational overhead.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading infrastructure and capacity delivery projects, including new region deployments, capacity expansion, or maintenance framework initiatives.

  • Coordinating model onboarding and production delivery, from infrastructure readiness to successful customer availability.

  • Building and maintaining execution plans, identifying risks early, and ensuring blockers are resolved before they impact delivery.

  • Working closely with engineering managers, technical leads, product managers, SRE, infrastructure, networking, security, and other platform teams.

  • Facilitating technical decision-making and ensuring ownership and accountability across complex cross-team projects.

  • Continuously improving engineering delivery processes to make execution more predictable while maintaining a sustainable pace for engineering teams.


Requirements

  • Excellent project management and delivery skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into executable plans

  • Ability to identify critical paths, manage complex dependency graphs, and coordinate multiple parallel workstreams

  • Strong risk management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to make progress in fast-changing environments

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Comfortable leading incident coordination, facilitating discussions, documenting decisions, and driving follow-up actions

  • Strong technical background that allows you to understand engineering discussions, infrastructure dependencies, and architectural trade-offs without being the primary implementer

 

It will be an added bonus if you have

  • Experience working with GPU infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, or large-scale inference systems

  • Experience delivering cloud infrastructure or data center deployment pr
